_what: The media editor's session, versions and track check as routes (src/work-media-session.mjs), with their numbers and words as DATA. `facts` are the keys the person's store keeps them under ({id} is the edit or recording id). `commands` are the ways an edit command changes the edit's state by a path: set a value, take one away, insert into a list, remove from a list; a new way is a new row naming one of `how`. `most_path` and `most_value_bytes` bound a command, `most_log_entries` how many commands are kept after the newest snapshot, `most_tracks` how many tracks one check takes.

words.bad_command: That change could not be understood: {why}
words.bad_body: Send the choices as an object.
words.bad_tracks: Name 1 to {most} tracks, each with an id, wall_clock_ms and first_timestamp_ms.
words.unknown_action: That version action is not one this recording has.
words.stored: The edit's history could not be kept, so the change was not made.
